subject: MAP: Conditional sandbox cadence & data-lease terms for Monarch Retail evaluation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@monarchretail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-08T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation — dataset & prompt pack access

Sofia — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Monarch is ready to move from a PoC to a time-boxed evaluation, but procurement has asked for a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that clarifies: delivery cadence, usage constraints, take-down procedures, and acceptance gates.

High-level asks from our side:
- One-week ephemeral sandbox for model probing (we'll run approx. 5k queries/day)
- Access to a prompt pack and 2k labeled test cases for acceptance
- Strict no-redistribution clause and 90-day retention limit for logs

Can you share a short MAP and the data-lease term sheet we would sign? Procurement copied on this thread: procurements@monarchretail.com.

Best,
Liam
Head of Product, Monarch Retail
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam@monarchretail.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Conditional sandbox cadence & data-lease terms for Monarch Retail evaluation

Hi Liam — great to hear. Attaching a draft MAP and a compact data-lease term sheet for procurement review (see attachments). Summary below so procurement has a quick scan: 

Summary of proposed MAP (one-page):
- Sandbox window: 7 days ephemeral test environment, start date to be mutually agreed (we propose 2027-09-20 to align with internal capacity).
- Assets delivered: prompt pack (monarch_promptpack_v1.zip), 2,000 test cases (read-only), short README with acceptance metrics
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only; no public redistribution; derived prompts allowed for internal evaluation but not for commercial redistribution; logs retained 90 days then auto-purged unless a compliance hold is requested
- Acceptance gates:
  * Functional parity smoke tests (owner: Monarch) — pass threshold 85% on labeled test cases
  * Performance sanity (latency SLOs) — Redwood to provide per-route latency breakdown during the window
- Take-down: automatic revocation of tokens and sandbox destroy within 48 hours after the window closes or if terms are violated
- Audit: daily audit export to a shared secure Drive link for the duration of the sandbox

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Procurement to review term-sheet PDF attached and flag any changes by EOD 2027-09-13
2) If accepted, we finalize MAP spreadsheet (attached) and sign DocuSign; then we schedule a kickoff to seed the sandbox
3) Assign a technical contact on both sides for burn-in cadence and emergency rollback policy

Attachments: MAP-draft-Monarch-20270908.xlsx, redwood-eval-data-lease-term-sheet.pdf, monarch_promptpack_v1.zip

If procurement prefers an MSA amendment instead of a standalone term sheet, we can do that too — happy to triage.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships — Evaluation Programs
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-09T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Conditional sandbox cadence & data-lease terms for Monarch Retail evaluation

Quick internal checklist before we send to procurement: 
- Confirm sandbox capacity: allocate 1 dedicated instance with burst to match 5k qps/day profile (infra ok; I will scope cost estimate) — owner: lauren_bishop
- Token model variant: serve on redwood-latency-opt-3b (fallback to quantized-3b if capacity constrained) — owner: karthik_iyer
- Audit export cadence: CSV dump to shared Drive daily; retention policy set to 90d by default — owner: infra-ops
- Legal redlines we should expect: indemnity cap, data-use clause language around derived prompts; pre-authorize redaction flows for logs

Two suggested updates to the draft MAP spreadsheet:
1) Add a line for 'ephemeral token expiry policy' (7 days + immediate revoke on breach)
2) Add fallback routing policy: if latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive minutes, traffic should be routed to the quantized-3b option and we notify Monarch.

I'll attach a short cost note and we can push the updated MAP back to Liam + procurement.

-lauren
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@monarchretail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monarch Procurement <procurements@monarchretail.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Conditional sandbox cadence & data-lease terms for Monarch Retail evaluation

Thanks — this looks good and answers most procurement questions. A couple of quick clarifications before we route to legal: 
- Can you confirm that audit exports will be scoped to query id + timestamp + masked user identifiers (Monarch will not receive raw PII)?
- We prefer the start date to be 2027-09-22 (shifted +2 days). Is that OK?
- Procurement asked if Redwood can accept signing the term-sheet as a short addendum to our existing MSA rather than a standalone contract — that would speed internal approval.

If you confirm the above, we'll route to Legal/Procurement and come back with a signature window within 48 hours.

On the MAP items, please assign a single technical on-call for the sandbox window so we have one escalation path.

Best,
Liam
Head of Product, Monarch Retail
